name: interview-me
title_zh: 用一问一答逼出你真正想要的，而非你以为想要的
tagline_zh: 当需求含糊如“做个X”却没“给谁用”“为何现在”，它不猜，不补全，而是一问一答盘问到你95%确信底层意图。
tagline_en: When your ask is vague—"build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"—it doesn't guess or fill gaps. It interviews.
desc_en: Extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Achieves this through one-question-at-a-time interview until ~95% confidence about the underlying intent. Use when an ask is underspecified ("build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"), when the user explicitly invokes ("interview me", "grill me", "are we sure?", "stress-test my thinking"), or when you catch yours
why_zh: 它不靠提示词模板，而是动态生成追问序列，每问基于你的回答收敛意图。机制上像贝叶斯更新，而非静态清单。
why_en: No prompt templates—it dynamically generates follow-up questions, each narrowing intent based on your answers. Mechanically like.
limit_zh: 只适用于需求模糊、需澄清意图的场景。若需求已明确（如“给60岁父母做语音提醒”），它仍会盘问，浪费你时间。
limit_en: Only for vague asks needing intent clarification. If your need is already clear (e.g., "voice reminders for 60-year-old parents"), it still.
title_en: Interview to extract what you truly want, not what you.
